test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person sold an article at a loss of 7%. Had he sold it at a gain of 10.5%, he would have received Rs. 105 more. To gain 11%, he should have sold it (in Rs.) for:
solution:
**Given**

loss = 7%

gain = 10.5%

cost price - loss + 105 = cost price + profit

**Formula used**

selling price = cost price - loss

selling price = cost price + profit

**Calculation**

According to question

Let the cost price of an article is x

cost price - loss + 105 = cost price + profit

x - 7% of x + 105 = x + 10.5% of x

⇒ (93x/100) + 105 = (110.5x/100)

⇒ 105 = (110.5/100) - (93x/100)

⇒ 105 = (17.5x/100)

⇒ x = (105 × 100)/17.5

⇒ x = 600

Selling price to gain 11% = 600 + 11% of 600

⇒ 600 + 66

⇒ 666

**∴ To gain 11% selling price should be Rs.666.**
